title: Order overview & tracking
problem: One order can contain several products, while tracking and fulfilment details live at different levels.
decision: Keep the order tracking timeline visible above the product and summary panels.
benefit: Gives order operations a clear starting point before acting on a particular item.
hotspots: Order tracking
The timeline communicates the overall order state before an action is taken.
Product details
Ordered items stay visible as separate records rather than being collapsed into one action.
Order summary
Totals and customer context remain close to the item list for quick verification.

title: Cancel selected item
problem: A whole-order cancellation can affect products a customer still wants.
decision: Put the cancellation action and a reason field on the chosen product, with a final confirmation.
benefit: Supports more precise cancellations without unnecessarily affecting other items.
hotspots: Selected product
The dialog identifies which exact product is being cancelled.
Cancellation reason
A reason keeps the exception understandable when the request is reviewed.
Explicit confirmation
The final action is separated from the safe exit to reduce unintended cancellations.

title: Replacement fulfilment
problem: The original return and the replacement shipment are different stages of an exchange.
decision: Show the replacement product with a dedicated fulfilment timeline and related tracking data.
benefit: Makes the replacement stage visible without confusing it with the initial purchase.
hotspots: Status timeline
Shows progress across exchange and replacement delivery stages.
Original and replacement
Separates the original product from the replacement record.
Shipment information
Delivery and package details remain connected to the replacement.

title: Payment & refund history
problem: Refund status can be hard to interpret when payment details are disconnected from order history.
decision: Use a dedicated payment and refund view inside Order Details with relevant transaction details.
benefit: Keeps refund actions and completed records reviewable in their order context.
hotspots: Payment & refund tab
Separates financial activity from the order overview.
Refund details
Shows the refund record alongside the cancelled item.
Order context
Customer and order totals remain available when reviewing a refund.

title: Initiate a refund
problem: A refund must be associated with the correct cancelled product and amount.
decision: Review item and refund details in a focused confirmation dialog before initiating the action.
benefit: Encourages verification of the intended refund before submission.
hotspots: Refund item
The dialog displays the cancelled product and its attributes.
Refund amount
The payment and refund amounts are visible before confirmation.
Confirm refund
The action explicitly records the decision to initiate a refund.

title: Record manual COD refund
problem: Cash-on-delivery refunds cannot rely on the same automated payment reversal path.
decision: Capture UPI or bank-transfer details, a transaction reference and the refund date when recording a manual refund.
benefit: Leaves a traceable payment record for an otherwise manual process.
hotspots: Payment method
The operator selects the appropriate manual refund channel.
Transaction reference
A UPI or bank-transfer reference supports reconciliation.
Record the refund
Confirmation follows the payment details rather than just changing a status.

title: Order delay exception
problem: A delayed order needs an explicit explanation so fulfilment status is not ambiguous.
decision: Use a focused order-delay dialog to record a reason and optional description.
benefit: Makes order-level exceptions easier to interpret and communicate.
hotspots: Delay reason
A reason is required for the exception.
Additional context
The description can capture details beyond the reason category.
Mark as delayed
The state change is an explicit, reviewable action.
